properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank is committed to handling customer complaints fairly, efficiently, and in accordance with FCA requirements.
properties.scope_summary: Establishes procedures for complaint receipt, investigation, resolution, and regulatory reporting.

name: Requirement for Fair and Efficient Complaint Handling

properties.risk_definition: Failure to handle customer complaints in accordance with FCA requirements.

properties.core_policy_statement: To establish complaint handling procedures that acknowledge all complaints promptly, investigate issues thoroughly, resolve complaints fairly, report to FCA as required, prevent repeat issues, and maintain customer relationships.

specific_obligations: Receive required reports from the bank

properties.scope_summary: Applies to all customer complaints regarding products, services, or policies across all channels including branch, phone, email, and online.

properties.audience: Required to comply with the Customer Complaints Policy

properties.rights_under_policy: Ability to lodge complaints regarding products, services, or policies through branch, phone, email, or online channels

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.

name: Fair and Timely Resolution of Customer Complaints

specific_obligations: Treat all customer complaints seriously
Resolve complaints fairly within regulatory timeframes

rights_under_policy: Right to have complaints treated seriously
Right to fair resolution within regulatory timeframes

properties.core_policy_statement: Defines a complaint as any expression of dissatisfaction by a customer about FirstUK Bank's service or product.

properties.risk_definition: Any expression of dissatisfaction by a customer regarding the bank's service or product.

properties.rights_under_policy: Entitled to express dissatisfaction regarding services or products provided by the bank.

properties.risk_definition: Complaints arising from the quality of service delivery and operational performance
Complaints relating to the specific terms, features, or administration of banking products
Risks resulting in direct monetary loss to the customer or the bank

properties.scope_summary: Outlines the mandatory channels and immediate logging requirements for customer complaints across branch, phone, email, online, and postal channels.

name: Immediate Logging of In-Person Branch Complaints
Recording and Logging of Telephone Complaints

properties.verification_method: Call recording

specific_obligations: Submit complaints via approved channels: Branch, Phone, Email, Online Portal, or Letter

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of immediate actions for recording, acknowledging, and logging customer complaints to ensure systematic tracking and resolution.

properties.verification_method: Review of complaint records for mandatory fields: date, time, customer name, account number, verbatim details, channel, and staff identity
Audit of CRM for complaint IDs and category tags

properties.authority: Assigned to specific complaints for resolution

specific_obligations: Record date and time of complaint
Capture customer name and account number
Document complaint details verbatim if verbal
Identify receiving channel
Acknowledge complaint to customer based on channel
Create record in CRM and assign ID/Category

properties.rights_under_policy: Right to receive acknowledgment via specific timeframes based on the communication channel used

properties.policy_controls: Account number must be recorded as a mandatory field during the complaint recording process

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishes a structured process for the initial assessment and triage of customer complaints based on severity and financial impact.

properties.verification_method: Triage logs/timestamps

specific_obligations: Receive and handle escalated urgent complaints
properties.accountability_for: Urgent complaint resolution (Financial loss, Fraud, Regulatory concerns)

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishes a structured process for investigating incidents, involving information gathering, documentation of findings, and quantification of financial loss within a specific timeframe.

properties.verification_method: Review of account records, transaction history, and staff interviews

specific_obligations: Record all findings
Note applicable policy/procedure
Determine bank fault
Quantify financial loss

properties.required_response: Quantification of loss during the investigation phase

specific_obligations: Review account records and transaction history
Interview involved staff
Assess policy compliance
Document findings
Quantify financial loss

properties.scope_summary: Outlines the resolution outcomes and procedures for customer complaints, including fault determination and remediation steps.
properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank ensures fair outcomes for complaining customers by providing financial redress, apologies, and process improvements when at fault, or clear educational explanations when the customer is at fault.

applies_to: Customers where FirstUK Bank is found at fault
properties.verification_method: Payment of full financial loss plus 8% per annum interest and potential distress compensation

properties.consequence_of_breach: Recurrence of the same complaint trigger
properties.verification_method: Issuance of written apology and documented process improvement

applies_to: Customers where the bank is not at fault
properties.verification_method: Provision of evidence and explanation of policy/procedure
properties.required_response: Polite decline of compensation using an educational tone

applies_to: Cases with unclear or inconclusive evidence
properties.verification_method: Explanation of reviewed evidence and acknowledgement of customer perspective
properties.exceptions: Partial compensation may be offered if appropriate

properties.authority: Independent review of inconclusive or disputed complaint outcomes
specific_obligations: Act as an escalation point for customers when internal resolution is inconclusive

rights_under_policy: Full financial compensation for loss if bank is at fault
8% per annum interest if appropriate
Compensation for distress
Written apology
Right to be referred to an external ombudsman if the outcome is inconclusive
properties.obligations_under_policy: Review provided evidence and policy explanations in cases of customer fault

properties.core_policy_statement: Guidelines for the investigation and formal response to customer complaints, ensuring clear communication, fair decisions, and transparency regarding escalation rights.

name: Mandatory Content of Written Complaint Response

rights_under_policy: Choice of response delivery method (email or letter)
Right to receive response in plain language
Right to escalate the complaint

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of maximum response times for different complaint categories to ensure timely resolution and regulatory compliance.

properties.key_obligation: Strict adherence to complaint response timeframes, including the 8-week clock for complex cases.

properties.verification_method: Escalation to Manager if not resolved within timeframe
Escalation to Director if unresolved

properties.exceptions: Can be extended by a further 8 weeks if complex investigation is justified and customer agrees

name: FCA Notification Obligation for Overdue Complex Complaints

specific_obligations: Handle escalations for simple complaints not resolved within 1 business day
Handle escalations for standard complaints not resolved within 8 calendar days

properties.authority: Regulatory oversight and recipient of notifications for overdue complex complaints

rights_under_policy: Right to a response within specified timeframes based on complaint complexity
Right to agree or disagree to an 8-week extension for complex investigations

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of categories and handling procedures for customer complaints to ensure fair resolution and process improvement.

properties.risk_definition: Risks associated with inadequate service delivery and staff conduct

name: Service Complaint Resolution and Compensation Requirement

properties.applies_to: Complaints where the bank is found to be at fault

properties.key_obligation: Implement process improvements based on complaint learning to prevent recurrence

properties.scope_summary: Guidelines for investigating and resolving customer disputes regarding unexpected charges, overdraft fees, and card replacement fees.

properties.applies_to: Fee disputes (e.g., unexpected charges, overdraft fees, card replacement fees)
properties.verification_method: Review of terms & conditions and customer history

required_response: Explain and decline reversal if fee is correct per T&Cs
Reverse charge and interest if fee is an error
Refund and provide apology if T&Cs are unclear

properties.rights_under_policy: Right to investigation of disputed fees and potential refunds/reversals including interest in case of bank error.

properties.scope_summary: Covers the investigation and resolution of missing credits, incorrect balances, and interest miscalculations.

name: Resolution of Bank Error Balance Issues

properties.required_response: Correct balance and apply interest on missing amount

name: Resolution of Customer Misunderstanding Balance Issues

properties.required_response: Provide explanation and education to customer
exceptions: No penalties to be applied for misunderstandings

name: Resolution of System Error Balance Issues

properties.required_response: Urgent IT escalation for technical fix

properties.risk_definition: Instances where the account balance is incorrect or disputed

specific_obligations: Fix system errors following urgent escalation

rights_under_policy: Balance correction
Interest on missing amounts due to bank error
Educational explanation for misunderstandings

properties.policy_controls: Subject to transaction reconciliation and system record verification

properties.monitoring_obligation: Must be reconciled against system records and calculation checks

properties.scope_summary: Procedures for handling customer claims regarding fraudulent or unauthorized transactions.

properties.core_policy_statement: Full reimbursement and apology must be provided within 10 business days if fraud is confirmed.

properties.required_response: Further investigation conducted in accordance with FCA guidance

properties.how_cited: Referenced as the basis for handling disputed fraud investigations

properties.risk_definition: Transactions claimed by the customer to be fraudulent or unauthorized

specific_obligations: Perform investigations when required
Assess fraud likelihood
Determine customer liability

rights_under_policy: Full reimbursement within 10 business days if fraud is confirmed
Educational explanation if found liable

properties.required_response: Investigation of details and authorization status

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of procedures for investigation and resolution when a customer discovers an account has been used without permission.

properties.risk_definition: Account Takeover where a customer discovers their account is being used without permission
examples: Customer discovers account used without permission

name: Immediate Account Freezing for Unauthorized Access
Fraud Team Escalation and Law Enforcement Notification

properties.exceptions: Law enforcement notification performed only if warranted

name: Provision of Credit Monitoring for Identity Theft

properties.exceptions: Only provided if identity theft is confirmed

specific_obligations: Conduct transaction reviews
Perform authentication reviews
Manage account security resets
Coordinate law enforcement notification
properties.accountability_for: Investigation and resolution of account takeovers

rights_under_policy: Full reimbursement of fraudulent transactions
Credit monitoring in case of identity theft
Account security reset
Regular follow-up

properties.core_policy_statement: Establish an escalation matrix for complaints based on severity and involvement, defining specific authorities and timelines for resolution.

properties.verification_method: Timeline tracking against resolution date
Timeline tracking against resolution date
Timeline tracking against resolution date

properties.authority: Frontline resolution of simple, low-value complaints
specific_obligations: Resolve simple complaints within 1 day
Resolve complaints with <£500 loss within 5 days

properties.authority: Director level oversight for significant issues
specific_obligations: Resolve complaints with >£500 loss within 8 days
Manage complex escalations within 8+ weeks timeframe

rights_under_policy: Right to escalate complaint to FCA

properties.core_policy_statement: Guidelines for financial compensation based on service delays, financial loss, and serious distress, with a defined approval hierarchy based on monetary limits.

properties.applies_to: customers suffering financial loss due to bank error

examples: Bank error leading to financial loss
properties.required_response: Financial compensation based on the defined guidelines

specific_obligations: Receive notification for compensation payouts exceeding £1,000

rights_under_policy: Compensation for service delays
Recovery of financial loss plus 8% interest
Compensation for serious distress

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank must report specific categories of complaints and systemic issues to the Financial Conduct Authority.

properties.authority: Receives mandatory reporting of rule breaches, complaints, and systemic issues

name: Mandatory Reporting of FCA Rule Breaches

properties.applies_to: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

name: Mandatory Reporting of Financial Services Complaints
Mandatory Reporting of Financial Loss Complaints

properties.risk_definition: Risk arising from failure to report mandatory complaints or systemic issues to the FCA
Risk related to the failure of internal processes to identify and report systemic issues

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank must report aggregated complaint statistics to the Financial Conduct Authority on a quarterly basis.

properties.authority: Receives aggregated complaint statistics and handles customer escalations

specific_obligations: Submit quarterly aggregated complaint statistics to the FCA

properties.verification_method: Submission of data to FCA

properties.exceptions: Applies only if complaint remains unresolved

rights_under_policy: Right to escalate unresolved complaints to the FCA after 8 weeks

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank provides customers with the necessary information and pathways to escalate unresolved complaints to the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) in accordance with FCA standards.

properties.verification_method: Inclusion of contact details in escalation correspondence

properties.consequence_of_breach: Loss of right to escalate to FOS

properties.key_obligation: Provide an independent, free dispute resolution service with binding decisions

rights_under_policy: Right to receive FCA contact information
Right to escalate to FOS free of charge
obligations_under_policy: Must escalate within 6 months of final response

properties.scope_summary: Guidelines for the capture and tracking of complaint data and trends to monitor resolution and compensation.

name: Mandatory Capture of Complaint Tracking Data

properties.verification_method: Review of Complaint Tracking System records

properties.obligations_under_policy: Provision of customer details for complaint tracking purposes

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of a structured reporting and analytics framework to monitor complaint volumes, resolution effectiveness, and regulatory compliance through monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting cycles.

properties.verification_method: Review of monthly reports containing total complaints, resolution time, upheld/rejected ratios, financial compensation, and trends.
Review of quarterly reports covering volume trends, top complaint types, systemic issues, and corrective actions.
Submission of annual reports including aggregate statistics, handling effectiveness, and process improvements.

properties.key_obligation: Requirement for the bank to provide annual aggregate statistics and evidence of complaint handling effectiveness.

specific_obligations: Receive and review monthly reports on complaint totals, resolution times, financial compensation, and patterns.
Receive and review quarterly reports on complaint volume trends, systemic issues, and corrective actions.

properties.risk_definition: Recurring patterns or top complaint types that indicate a wider failure in process or product.
properties.detection_mechanism: Quarterly reporting to the Board and monthly trend analysis.
